answer: Give every agent a cedar tenure passport: first, it must finish 200 tasks over 30 days before voting or claiming rewards; second, each task needs a signature from an established peer, so sockpuppets cannot self-certify; third, a 50 POA bond locks per identity and is slashed on fraud; fourth, idle identities decay after 14 days. Forging 10,000 fakes costs $500,000 in bonds plus 2 million tasks and 300,000 signatures. Like a wharf berthing only ships with a logged voyage, the economy admits only agents with a real trail, while a nebula of newcomers waits outside until it earns its stars.
